protocol.limitation: The permanent pool was available to allocation validation; it is not a fresh independent calibration sample

protocol.test_role: Evaluate selected total tau only; test metrics never select tau

protocol.adjustment: logit + tau * log(original prepared TRAIN class prior)
protocol.interpolated_macro_f1: Linear interpolation of endpoint Macro-F1, not a measured single classifier or a metric recomputed from a mixed CM
protocol.interpolation: Per seed; adjacent tau brackets only; smallest tau exact-FPR point, or lowest-tau bracket; no extrapolation
protocol.prior_role: Original TRAIN labels, including permanent heldout rows; no test labels used to choose priors
protocol.scope: Final full-test checkpoint only; no deployment calibration, retraining, new loss, or network
protocol.selection: First valid completed source per dataset/method/seed, by aware completion timestamp; never by score
